findings.feature_title: Synthetic example: legacy account endpoint retirement
findings.rationale: The fictional integration calls the exact endpoint that the synthetic release removes. Update the integration before upgrading.

test_case.title: Verify account sync after endpoint migration
steps: Point a test copy of the integration at /v2/accounts.
Run a sync with a known test account.
Compare the resulting billing record with the source account.
test_case.expected: The integration completes and the billing record matches the test account.

findings.object_description: A fictional integration reads the legacy accounts endpoint each night and sends account updates to billing.
findings.feature_description: In this fictional release, the /legacy/accounts endpoint is removed. Account integrations must use /v2/accounts before upgrading.

findings.snippet: Subject area: Service Backlog; measures: open request count
findings.feature_title: Synthetic example: service backlog report grouping
findings.rationale: The fictional report uses the affected subject area. The release preserves columns, so verify aggregation behavior without assuming breakage.
findings.cited_text: verify totals when using queue grouping

test_case.title: Compare service backlog totals
steps: Record totals for a fixed set of service requests.
Run the report after the update with and without queue grouping.
Reconcile both totals against the fixed input set.
test_case.expected: Grouped and ungrouped totals match the known service request count.

findings.object_description: A fictional report aggregates service backlog counts and exports totals for operations.
findings.feature_description: In this fictional release, the service backlog subject area gains an optional queue grouping column. Existing report columns remain available; verify totals when using queue grouping.

findings.feature_title: Synthetic example: optional service request summaries
findings.rationale: The optional fictional feature may replace manual summary drafting. An agent should compare its output with the current process before adoption.
findings.cited_text: administrators can opt in to automatic service request summaries

test_case.title: Evaluate automatic summaries against manual summaries
steps: Enable the optional feature in a test environment.
Generate a summary for a sample request with known notes.
Have an agent compare it with the manually maintained summary.
test_case.expected: The agent can review a draft containing the important facts from the sample request notes.

findings.object_description: Agents manually copy service request notes into a custom summary field.
findings.feature_description: In this fictional release, administrators can opt in to automatic service request summaries. The feature drafts a summary from service request notes for an agent to review.
